items.text: saved files are named and numbered: CHAMY·XYZ_Current_App_000001.jpg, one running number for cards, stills and videos; cards save as .jpg
cards with the look behind carry a small duck-rabbit in the bottom right corner, on the margins, as wide (without the rabbit's tail) as the namemark's two turned words
CURRENT on the cards is not letterspaced

cards on the CHAMY·XYZ brand grid: a margin of a twelfth of the short side on every edge; the namemark's x-height on the top and right margins; CURRENT down the left column, its capitals one margin tall; CHAMY·XYZ on the left and bottom margins, its capitals the namemark's x-height; the sentence's last line on the bottom margin; the duck-rabbit in the room left. The same composition at every size
share cards carry the real CHAMY·XYZ wordmark, not the name typed in a font
one caret over a bar button on hover, not two (a second caret had been added on Source, Sound, Tools and Capture)

cards on one grid: the namemark comes in to CURRENT's inset; the back of CURRENT's C sits on Dimitry's baseline (lying flat, the two share a baseline); CHAMY·XYZ shares CURRENT's baseline and runs the namemark's width
cards carry no QR code: they are seen on the phone that would scan them. The link you share still opens the exact look
cards: the duck-rabbit slides toward the middle of the room the type leaves (it crowded CURRENT on the 4:5 post), then grows back as far as it can

how the two colors alternate has its own tab in the Color mixer, Mix, after Second: grain, in time (with its seconds) or motion, each explained, plus add or remove the second color. It leaves the color shelf

the color editor: tap or hold the big swatch in the Color mixer (or its edit label), or hold any swatch, and an editor slides down inside the panel: lightness, chroma and hue, a hex code, the device's color field, and save to My colors
holding a dot on the color shelf selects it and opens that editor; "your own" is gone
My colors, a row of the colors you saved, in every group
the toolpath has a color: the G-code's own drawing is a group in the color shelf and the mixer (tap its lit dot to hide it), animatable, kept with looks. Travel moves turn dark on a light ground
